transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Yeah, um… thanks. I guess I’m here because things at home have been getting to me more than I’d like to admit. Since my father-in-law moved in, I’ve been… kind of short with my wife over little house stuff, which isn’t really how I want to be.

And I’ve been putting off jobs and paperwork I usually keep up with. Nothing too dramatic, I hope, but it’s not like me. Even when I’m out in the workshop or trying to fish, I can’t really get my head to quiet down. I figured I should talk to someone before I make things worse, if that makes sense.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um… I’d say about five months now. It started not too long after my father-in-law moved in with us. I kept thinking it would settle down, you know, maybe just an adjustment period, but it’s been hanging around longer than I expected.
Have you noticed any loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy, like working in the workshop or fishing?

I’m not sure I’d call it a loss of interest, exactly. I mean, I still want to do those things… workshop stuff, fishing, all that. I guess I don’t always enjoy them as much in the moment, maybe because my mind’s elsewhere. But it’s not like I’ve stopped caring about them, if that makes sense.
Have you noticed feeling down or having a low mood most days, even when there’s nothing specific bothering you?

Not really most days, no. I mean, I have moments where I feel kind of worn down or discouraged, but it usually feels tied to something going on at home. I wouldn’t say I’m just low for no reason all the time… at least, I don’t think so. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Do you find yourself worrying a lot or having trouble turning off your thoughts, even when you’re trying to relax or do something you enjoy?

Yeah… I guess that’s probably the main thing, honestly. I try not to make too big a deal of it, but since my father-in-law moved in, I just can’t seem to get my head to quiet down.

Even if I’m out in the workshop or trying to fish, I’m thinking about stuff at the house, little things I need to deal with, or things I’m frustrated about. And then I’ll end up snapping at my wife over something small, which I don’t feel good about. I’ve also been putting off jobs and paperwork I’d normally stay on top of. I don’t know if that’s the kind of worrying you mean, but it feels like my mind just keeps running.
Have you noticed yourself getting more irritable than usual or having trouble concentrating on tasks, even when they’re things you normally handle without a problem?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but yes. I’ve been more short-tempered than I’d like, especially with my wife, over little house things that probably shouldn’t bother me that much.

And concentrating has been harder too. I’ve been putting off jobs and paperwork that I normally would just handle. It’s like since my father-in-law moved in, my head doesn’t really quiet down, even when I’m out in the workshop or trying to fish. I keep thinking about stuff at home. Does that answer what you’re asking?
Have you noticed any physical changes, like feeling more restless, tense, or tired than usual, even when you’re not doing much?

I’m not really sure. I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed anything major like that. Maybe I get a little keyed up sometimes, but I haven’t really been tracking it, you know?

I don’t want to overstate it. Physically, I think I’m mostly okay… unless there’s something specific you mean that I should be paying attention to?
Have you noticed feeling tired or having low energy most days, even if you haven't been doing much?

I don’t think so… not most days, anyway. I mean, I get worn out like anybody does, but I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed being low-energy when I haven’t done much.

Maybe I’m not paying close enough attention, but it doesn’t feel like that’s been a big thing for me. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you had trouble falling asleep or staying asleep, even when you felt like you should be able to rest?

I don’t think that’s been a big problem, no. I mean, some nights I might lie there thinking for a bit, but I wouldn’t say I’m regularly unable to fall asleep or waking up all night.

I’m sleeping okay, I think… at least enough that it hasn’t stood out to me. Is that helpful?
Do you find that your worry or anxiety about things at home or other parts of your life feels excessive or harder to control than you’d expect it to be?

Yeah… I guess that’s probably fair to say. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but since my father-in-law moved in, I feel like I can’t quite shut my head off.

It’s mostly home stuff, little things around the house, and then I’m snapping at my wife over things I know aren’t that big. I’ve also been putting off jobs and paperwork I used to just handle. Even when I go out to the workshop or try to fish, I’m still turning it over in my mind.

So… yes, harder to control than I’d like, I suppose. Does that make sense?
Have you noticed these symptoms, like irritability, trouble concentrating, or ongoing worry, happening even when there isn’t a specific stressor or problem at home to explain them?

I think it’s mostly tied to what’s been going on at home, honestly. I’m here because ever since my father-in-law moved in, I’ve been snapping at my wife over little house things, and that’s not really how I want to be.

And I’ve been putting off jobs and paperwork I used to stay on top of. Even when I go out to the workshop or try to fish, I can’t quite get my head quiet. So… I wouldn’t say it comes out of nowhere, if that makes sense. It feels connected to that situation.
Have you noticed these symptoms—like irritability, trouble concentrating, or ongoing worry—happening in situations outside of home, such as at work or when you're out with friends?

Yeah… somewhat. I mean, I’m not working a regular job right now, so it’s not like coworkers are seeing it every day or anything.

But it has affected the repair work I do. I missed an important filing date for my contractor license, which… I’m embarrassed to even say that, because I usually keep track of those things. And I’ve had to turn down or put off a few small repair jobs because I just wasn’t keeping up the way I normally would.

It’s mostly showing up from the home situation, but it’s spilling over, I guess. And at home it’s definitely put more tension between my wife and me, and I’m not following through on family things as well as I should. Does that answer what you mean?
Have you noticed these symptoms, like irritability or trouble concentrating, happening even when things at home are calm or not actively bothering you?

I think… not really out of the blue, if that’s what you mean. It’s mostly tied to the situation at home since my father-in-law moved in.

That said, even when the house is calm for the moment, I still don’t always settle down. I’ll be out in the workshop or trying to fish, and my head just keeps going over things. And then I’m more short with my wife over little house stuff, or I put off jobs and paperwork I used to handle.

So I guess it’s not always because something is happening right that second, but it feels connected to all of that. Does that make sense?
Have you noticed feeling down, irritable, or having trouble concentrating even when things at home are going smoothly or there isn’t anything specific bothering you?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t think it’s completely random. It really started after my father-in-law moved in, and I feel like that’s the main thing behind it.

But even when the house is calm, I still catch myself not being able to shut my head off. I’ll go out to the workshop or try to fish, thinking that’ll clear it, and I’m still turning things over in my mind. And then I end up snapping at my wife over small house stuff, or putting off jobs and paperwork I used to keep up with.

I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but it’s been enough that I figured I should probably talk to someone. Does that answer it right?
Have you noticed these symptoms—like irritability, trouble concentrating, or ongoing worry—happening even when you're away from home or not thinking about the situation with your father-in-law?

Yeah… I think it does happen when I’m away from home, but I’d still say it’s tied to what’s been going on there.

Like, I’ll go out to the workshop or try to go fishing, kind of hoping I’ll just clear my head, and it doesn’t really shut off. I keep turning things over in my mind. And then it shows up in other ways too—snapping at my wife over little house things, putting off jobs or paperwork I used to be pretty good about staying on top of.

I don’t know if that’s exactly what you’re asking, but that’s the pattern I’ve noticed.
